sections.Profile:
The "Grand Prix" pinball machine, manufactured by Williams Electronics in 1976, is an electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche. The machine features a racing theme, prominently showcasing the city of Monaco on its backglass, inspired by the famous Monaco Grand Prix.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Racing, Sports, 1970s, Cars
